description: A contemporary single-story residence photographed at dusk from an exterior corner vantage, revealing the clean-lined stucco facade in pale warm grey. Three tall, narrow floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors with dark aluminium frames punctuate the facade, each framed by wide structural piers of the same smooth plaster render. Warm amber washes travel vertically up and down each pier, casting dramatic up-down glows that trace the full height of the wall and pool softly at grade level across a strip of manicured lawn. The sky behind the building grades from deep indigo at the top to a soft dusty blue at the horizon, silhouetting a leafless tree at the left and a rough-cut stone garden wall running parallel to the building. Through the large sliding panels at right, an interior living room is visible: a low cream sofa, a plush off-white area rug, and recessed ceiling illumination casting a calm warm interior glow. The garden in the foreground is immaculately clipped short grass. The overall palette is cool grey architecture set against a twilight blue sky, punctuated entirely by the deep amber vertical washes on the stucco piers. Camera is positioned at standing eye-level roughly five feet off grade, held level, using a moderately wide lens — approximately 24-28mm — in a three-quarter view of the building corner, placing the facade at an oblique angle so both the front wall and the side garden wall recede into the frame. The composition balances the lit exterior wall against the glowing interior visible through glass on the right.
